messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — several contract interviewers can't open the scorecard links in the interview confirmation emails. The link redirects to our SSO page (login loop). Any recent mailer changes?
Maria Gomez: Saw 3 reports today from contractors in EMEA. They get a 'must authenticate' screen instead of the standalone scorecard.
Jamal Rivera: That's bad. Are these the new ATS templates we rolled last week? @Emily any deploys?
Emily Park: Rolled mailer update Tue night but didn't touch link format. I'll check logs.
Recruiting Bot: Notification: ATS-emailer v2.4 deployed by @devops at 2026-03-22T03:12Z
Emily Park: Log shows the query param `t=` is being truncated in some messages — looks like URL-encoding issue in our template substitution.
Alex Chen: Example broken link: https://ats.example.com/scorecard?token=eyJhbGci... -> opens SSO
Maria Gomez: Example working link (from internal): https://ats.example.com/scorecard/view?guest=1&c=abcd
Jamal Rivera: Can we update templates to use guest token `guest=` when interviewer is contractor? How do we detect that?
Emily Park: ATS has role metadata. Quick patch in mailer: if role in ['contractor','vendor'] then generate guest token. I'll push a patch to staging and resend one test email.
Alex Chen: Can we also add fallback copy in email: 'If the link asks you to sign in, use this guest link: [shortlink]'
Maria Gomez: +1 — recruiters need this ASAP; we've pending interviews tomorrow.
Devops: Pushed branch `mailer/guest-link-fix`, tests pass. Staging email sent to jamal.test+contractor@redwood.com
Jamal Rivera: Received test — link opens scorecard as guest. ✅
Alex Chen: Deploying to prod? ETA?
Devops: Rolling to production now, will monitor 15m. :rocket:
Emily Park: Also adding a small metric to track 401s on scorecard endpoint.
Maria Gomez: Amazing, thanks team. Can we backfill for the 6 affected interviews? Manual resend ok?
Alex Chen: I'll ask recruitment ops to resend confirmations with new links.
Recruiting Bot: Incident closed: guest-link-issue - resolved 2026-03-22T03:58Z
Maria Gomez: 🎉
